HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

2. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   C. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

10. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.

13. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

15. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
